changelog:
Enhanced Resources & Refined Experience

This release brings new development resources, improved customization, and a more refined interface. Explore new code palettes and local libraries, enjoy the new Fading Edge setting, and benefit from updated resources and visual enhancements.

⦁ Added:
 ▫ New code palettes and local libraries added to Sketchy Codex for easier access and faster development.
 ▫ New Fading Edge setting to customize the fading effect on scrollable views.

⦁ Updated:
 ▫ Existing code snippets and local libraries updated for better functionality, compatibility, and clarity.
 ▫ Some UI colors adjusted for better visual balance and consistency throughout the app.

⦁ Improved:
 ▫ App UI refined with visual enhancements for a cleaner, smoother, and more consistent user experience.

⦁ Fixed:
 ▫ Old version entries refined — Version 23.611.80 alpha3's  have been correctly merged.
